title: Munat Sacrificio luraña
intro: Diosan yantʼanakapajj utjkäna uka tiemponjja, mä almaw qhep qhepa lurañatak jawsatäna. Mä jan wawani oraqen jilsuwayasajja, uka jaqejj iyawsäwi ukat paciencia uñachtʼayañatakiw jiljjattäna. Kunapachatï mä visionajj mä sacrificio loqtañatak mayïna ukhajja, janiw aynachtʼapkänti. Jupanakan sarnaqäwipax devoción ukan mä esquina qalawa.
clues: Nayajj mä jachʼa profetan walja tiempo suytʼat mayisitaparuw jaysatäyäta.
Mamajampi nayampejj mä chʼusa vallenwa qheparapjjta, ukanjja dátil ukat umakiw utjäna.
Chiqpach parlatajata ukat paciencianïtajat uñtʼat profetaruw jilsuwayta.
Nayax tatajaruw mä qullan utan cimientonakap jiltayañ yanapt’awayta, ukax Allah ukar katuyatawa.
Tatajajj mä samkan sacrificiot loqtañ yatiyäna ukhajja, akham sasaw sista: ‘Kunjämtï sisktam ukarjam luram’ sasa.
Allah jupax nayan jaysatax jach’añchawayitu, alaxpachat mä oveja khithawayitu qhispiyañataki.

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
